key_effect_directions.claim: Piecewise/regime model beats smooth monotone spline by AIC >= 10 on both task families
Best bounded-S configuration outperforms the unlimited shared-log baseline
Accuracy rises from near single-agent at S=1 to substantially higher by S>=8 on both families

forecast.rationale: Small 7B councils with discrete slot sweeps usually yield gradual capacity gains and context-length tradeoffs rather than a stable GWT-style jump; the dual PASS requirement (AIC>=10 on two families plus bottleneck beating unlimited log) is therefore unlikely, while family-wise differences in any apparent kink can produce SPLIT or KILL.
